title: In bulk mode the actions menu offers only Export
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have at least one active part at the test location, so Export has a part to export.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Deactivate parts.
  3. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  4. Click Export.
  5. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
  6. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 3:

  • The menu holds a single entry, "Export".
  • "Cycle count" and "Deactivate parts" are not offered.

Step 4:

  • A file downloads, and the dark bar is still shown: bulk mode stays on.

Step 5:

  • Bulk mode ends.

Step 6:

  • With bulk mode ended, the menu again lists "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R10b: “While the mode is on, the actions menu offers only Export. Cycle count and the bulk entry come back when the mode ends.”
  • S2-E4: “Cycle count and bulk status mode cannot both be on. While Cycle count runs, the actions menu is replaced by the count controls, so the bulk status entry cannot be reached until the count is saved or discarded. While bulk status mode is on, the menu does not offer Cycle count (S2-R10b).”
